seo.title: Outlook integration | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect Microsoft Outlook to Steps AI and use it in workflows and skills to keep your team informed about tickets and leads.

hero.title: Bring Steps AI into your team’s Outlook.
hero.body: Connect your Microsoft Outlook account so workflows and skills can use it, for example to let your team know about new tickets or leads by email.
hero.reassurance: Connected once. Used in skills and workflows. Your team stays informed.

lines.text: I would like to speak to someone about a bulk order.
Of course. I have let our team know and someone will join this chat shortly.

useCases.title: What you can do with Outlook connected.
useCases.intro: Use Outlook as a step in your workflows and agent skills.

items.title: Email your team about tickets
items.body: Let the right people know by email when the agent raises a ticket or a customer asks for a person.

items.title: Share new leads
items.body: Send your sales team the details of a new lead captured in the chat.

items.title: Use it in workflows
items.body: Add Outlook as a step in a workflow alongside your store and other apps.

setup.title: Connect Outlook in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Outlook
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Outlook. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Outlook to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Use it in a workflow or skill
items.body: Add a Outlook step to a workflow, or use it in a flow skill, and choose what it should do.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The actions available for Outlook depend on your setup. We will show you exactly what it can do in your demo.
Workflows save as drafts until you switch them on.

items.q: Where do I use Outlook after connecting it?
items.a: In the workflow builder and in flow skills, where a connected app can be chosen as an action.

items.q: Do I need to write code?
items.a: No. You choose steps from menus. Advanced options such as webhooks are there if your team wants them.

cta.title: See Steps AI work with Outlook.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using Outlook and your own information.
